title: Institution
description: Your institution's details, members and departments.

suspended.title: This institution is suspended
suspended.description: The Waqaya platform administration has temporarily suspended {org}. Its data is kept, but its pages cannot be viewed or changed until the suspension is lifted.
suspended.hint: Choose another institution or your individual account in Settings

composition.title: Members by role
composition.description: How the institution's members are spread across roles.

setup.title: Set up your institution
setup.description: Three short steps to get your team working on Waqaya.

details.title: Complete the institution's details
details.description: Set the institution type, and add its English name if someone on your team uses Waqaya in English.

invite.title: Invite your team
invite.description: Send invitations to examiners and trainees.

departments.title: Create departments
departments.description: Group members into departments such as the emergency room or intensive care.

links.label: Manage the institution
links.membersManage: Add members, change their roles and follow invitations.
links.membersView: Browse the institution's members and their roles.
links.departmentsManage: Create departments and assign members to them.
links.departmentsView: Browse the institution's departments and their members.
links.protocols: Customize your institution's protocols or copy them from the global ones.

profile.title: Edit institution details
profile.description: Members see the name in lists, reports and invitations.
profile.name: Institution name in Arabic
profile.nameEnHint: Optional. Shown to people who use Waqaya in English.

roleDescriptions.owner: Full control, including adding or removing other owners.
roleDescriptions.admin: Manages members, invitations, departments and institution protocols.
roleDescriptions.examiner: Runs smart scans, reviews their results and sees institution reports.
roleDescriptions.trainee: Trains with simulations and sees only their own results.

members.description: The institution's members, their roles and departments.
members.count: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {1 member} other {{n} members}}
members.readOnly: You can view the member list. The institution's owners and admins manage members.

blocked.owner_only: Only an owner can change an owner's role.
blocked.last_owner: The institution needs at least one owner.

changeRole.title: Change {name}'s role
changeRole.description: The role decides what the member sees and can do in the institution.
changeRole.selfWarning: You are changing your own role. After saving you can no longer manage members; the institution pages stay open to you, read-only.
changeRole.selfWarningTrainee: You are changing your own role. Trainees do not see the institution pages, so after saving this page closes and the dashboard opens.

remove.title: Remove {name} from the institution?
remove.description: The member loses access to the institution's data and departments right away. The scans they ran stay in the institution's records, and you can invite them again later.

invite.title: Invite a member to the institution
invite.description: We email a link that lets the person join the institution with the role you choose. The invitation stays valid for {days, plural, =0 {less than a day} one {1 day} other {{n} days}}.
invite.emailHint: The person must sign in or sign up with this same address.
invite.departmentHint: Optional. The member joins the department when they accept.
invite.noDepartments: No departments yet. You can create them on the Departments page.
invite.emailOff: Email is turned off on this server, so the invitation email will not arrive. Copy the link once the invitation is created and send it yourself.
invite.sentDescription: We emailed the invitation to <addr>{email}</addr>. If it does not arrive, copy the link and send it yourself.
invite.createdDescription: Copy the link and send it to <addr>{email}</addr> yourself: email is turned off on this server.
invite.linkHint: The link works only for the owner of this address.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Invitations that have not been accepted yet.
invitations.staleDescription: These invitations can no longer be accepted. Send a new invitation or cancel it.
invitations.inviterGone: The sender has left the institution
invitations.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the link and copy it yourself.
invitations.resentOff: Invitation extended. Email is off, so copy the link and send it yourself.
invitations.sentAgainOff: New invitation created. Copy its link and send it yourself.
invitations.cancelDescription: The invitation link stops working once it is canceled. You can send a new invitation later.
invitations.ownerOnly: Only an owner manages owner invitations.

departments.description: The institution's departments and their members, such as the emergency room, intensive care or the laboratory.
departments.createDescription: Create the department, then add the institution's members to it.
departments.name: Department name
departments.duplicate: A department with this name already exists.
departments.lastBlocked: An institution's only department cannot be deleted. Create another department first, or rename this one.
departments.deleteDescription: Its members stay in the institution with their roles; only the department is deleted. Invitations that name this department stay valid without a department.
departments.manageDescription: Add the institution's members to this department or remove them from it.
departments.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {1 member} other {{n} members}}
departments.count: {count, plural, =0 {No departments} one {1 department} other {{n} departments}}
departments.noMembers: No members in this department yet.
departments.addSearch: Search for a member to add
departments.allIn: Every member of the institution is in this department.
departments.readOnly: You can view the departments. The institution's owners and admins create and manage them.
departments.emptyManager: Create the first department to organize the institution's members and follow each department's results.
departments.emptyViewer: The institution's managers have not created departments yet.

open.title: Join {org}
open.description: {inviter} invited you to join this institution on Waqaya.
open.descriptionNoInviter: You were invited to join this institution on Waqaya.
open.declineDescription: You will not join {org}, and this link stops working once you decline. The institution can send you a new invitation later.

signIn.title: Sign in to accept the invitation
signIn.description: Sign in or create an account with <addr>{email}</addr>, and you will come back to this page.

wrongAccount.title: This invitation is for another account
wrongAccount.description: The invitation was sent to <addr>{email}</addr>, and you are signed in as <addr>{current}</addr>.
wrongAccount.hint: Sign out, then sign in with the address that received the invitation, and you will come back to this page.

alreadyMember.title: You are a member of {org}
alreadyMember.description: You do not need this invitation: you are already a member of the institution.

accepted.title: This invitation was already used
accepted.description: Your invitation to {org} was accepted before. If you need to join again, ask the institution's managers for a new invitation.

rejected.title: This invitation was declined
rejected.description: You will not join {org} through this link. If you change your mind, ask the institution's managers for a new invitation.

canceled.title: This invitation was canceled
canceled.description: Your invitation to {org} was canceled. Contact the institution if you expected to join.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Invitations expire after a set time. Ask the managers of {org} for a new one.

noLongerValid.title: This invitation is no longer valid
noLongerValid.description: The person who sent it is no longer a member of {org}. Ask the institution's managers for a new invitation.

suspended.title: The institution is temporarily suspended
suspended.description: The platform administration has temporarily suspended {org}, so the invitation cannot be accepted right now. Try again later.

invalidRole.title: This invitation cannot be accepted
invalidRole.description: The role in this invitation is not available in Waqaya. Ask the managers of {org} for a new invitation.

unknown.title: We could not find this invitation
unknown.description: Make sure you copied the whole link from the invitation email, or ask the institution for a new invitation.

errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.lockBusy: Another change is in progress. Try again in a moment.
errors.suspended: This institution is suspended by the platform administration, so it cannot be changed right now.
errors.deletionBlocked: This cannot be done right now. Make another member an owner of the institution first.
errors.lastOwner: The institution needs at least one owner. Make another member an owner first.
errors.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.ownerRoleOnly: Only an owner can give or take away the owner role.
errors.alreadyMember: The person with this address is already a member of the institution.
errors.alreadyInvited: An invitation was already sent to this address.
errors.invitationLimit: The institution has reached the limit of pending invitations. Cancel some, then try again.
errors.membershipLimit: The institution has reached its member limit.
errors.invalidEmail: The email address is not valid.
errors.memberNotFound: We could not find this member; they may have been removed. Refresh the page.
errors.departmentNotFound: We could not find this department; it may have been deleted. Refresh the page.
errors.lastDepartment: The institution's only department cannot be deleted. Create another one first, or rename this one.
errors.departmentInUse: You cannot delete this department right now. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.notInDepartment: This member is not in the department.
errors.invitationNotFound: The invitation is not valid: it may have expired or been used already.
errors.notRecipient: This invitation was sent to another address.
errors.verifyEmailFirst: Verify your email address first, then accept the invitation.
errors.organizationNotFound: We could not find this institution.
errors.invalidInput: Some of the values are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.departmentNameTaken: There is already a department with this name in the institution.
